title: An office question the lease cannot answer is answered from policy

grounding.expectRef: נוהל פנייה למשרד § שעות פעילות המשרד
grounding.note: The middle rung of lease → policy → refuse, and the case that proves the ordering is not just 'the lease, or nothing'. The lease does come back for this question — נספח ב׳ §1 states the complex's quiet hours — and it shares exactly one word with what was asked, where the policy shares three. The citation is spelled by the chunker, not by whoever wrote this case: renaming that heading in docs/guidance/office-contact.md turns this gate red, which is the feedback loop working.
